# hibira_app (Resource)

A Hibira app: one set of Pusher-compatible credentials (app ID, key and secret) with its own settings. Manage its webhooks with `hibira_webhook` and its push notifications with `hibira_push`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hibira_app" "chat" {
  name            = "chat-prod"
  client_events   = true
  allowed_origins = ["https://example.com"]
}

# Pass the credentials straight to where your backend runs.
output "pusher_config" {
  value = {
    app_id = hibira_app.chat.id
    key    = hibira_app.chat.key
    host   = hibira_app.chat.host
  }
}

output "pusher_secret" {
  value     = hibira_app.chat.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The app's name, up to 100 characters.

### Optional

- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) The web origins (such as `https://example.com`) that may connect. Empty allows any origin.
- `api_allowlist` (Set of String) IP addresses or CIDR ranges the app's HTTP API accepts (plans with an API allowlist only). Empty accepts any.
- `client_events` (Boolean) Whether clients may trigger `client-` events on private and presence channels. Defaults to `false`.
- `cluster` (String) The region the app runs in, such as `hkg`. Defaults to the account's default region. Changing it replaces the app.
- `edge_mode` (String) Edge fan-out: `auto`, `direct` or `edge` (plans with edge fan-out only). Left unset, the app keeps its current mode.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether clients and the HTTP API can use the app. Defaults to `true`.
- `history` (Boolean) Whether channel history is kept (plans with history only). Defaults to `false`.
- `secret_grace_minutes` (Number) How long the previous secret keeps working after a rotation, in minutes. Defaults to `60`.
- `secret_rotation` (String) Any value; changing it rotates the app's secret. The previous secret keeps working for `secret_grace_minutes`.
- `subscription_count` (Boolean) Whether channels send `pusher:subscription_count` events. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) The WebSocket host clients connect to (`wsHost` in pusher-js).
- `id` (String) The app ID (the Pusher `app_id`).
- `key` (String) The app key, used by clients.
- `plan` (String) The account plan the app runs on.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The app secret, for your server. Hibira returns it only when the app is created or its secret is rotated, so it is empty for an imported app until `secret_rotation` changes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An imported app's secret stays empty until secret_rotation changes.
terraform import hibira_app.chat app_123
```
